sentences.text: Hannah Price is the social worker from Harbridge children's services.
School contacted children's services because Millie told her teacher she didn't want to go home on Monday.
Stacey Lambert is the mother of Millie Lambert.
Millie Lambert is a child aged 9.
Craig is Millie's stepfather and works on the bins (i.e., waste collection).
Craig is at work until six and is not present at the time of the visit.
The family includes Stacey, Millie, Craig, and Jayden, who is two years old.
Millie's father is in Scotland and she sees him only during summer holidays.
Stacey works mornings at Greggs.
Craig is Millie's stepfather and the family has been together for four years.
The landlord is slow in fixing the damp in Millie's room.
Millie told the social worker that when she wets the bed, Craig hits her with a belt on her legs.
Millie said Craig hits her with a belt on her legs every time she wets the bed, and this happens about every week.
The last time Craig hit Millie was on Sunday morning, before Stacey woke up.
Millie said the hits leave red lines that go away.
Millie said no one else at home hurts her.
The social worker will speak to Mrs Hollis at school tomorrow morning to ask the school nurse to refer Millie to the continence clinic.
The social worker will write to the landlord about the damp in Millie's room by Friday.
The social worker will visit the house on Thursday, the 26th, to follow up on the damp issue.
Millie said she likes art and is in the netball team in Year Four.
Millie said Jayden, her younger brother, takes her pens.
Millie said she has a hamster named Biscuit who is asleep.
Stacey said she has not seen Craig hit Millie and has only seen it once or twice.
Stacey said Craig gives Millie a 'smack' with his belt on her legs, not hard, and it's not abuse.
Stacey said Craig comes from a strict family and she has told him to stop.
The social worker stated that hitting a child with a belt is not acceptable and that she will initiate a strategy discussion with her manager and the police.
The social worker asked if Craig could stay elsewhere to ensure Millie's safety tonight.
Stacey said Craig's brother lives on Canal Street and could host him.
Stacey agreed to keep Craig away from the house until further notice.
Stacey said she will ring Craig now to ask him to go to his brother's on Canal Street.
